description: DATUM DAHLEEZ Environmental Intelligence Platform - Complete Implementation Roadmap

stages.name: Session Persistence & Resume
stages.description: Save consultation state to localStorage; auto-restore on revisit.
acceptanceCriteria: Engine state serializes to JSON and stores under key 'eis_session'
On boot, if valid session exists, restore to last incomplete stage
User can manually restart from dashboard
Data persists across page reloads and browser restarts

stages.name: Multi-Stakeholder Mode
stages.description: Support multiple respondents (e.g., husband/wife/designer) contributing to one project brief.
acceptanceCriteria: Each contributor's answers tagged with role
Conflict resolution UI when answers differ

stages.name: Question Weighting Engine
stages.description: Critical questions weighted higher; impact downstream recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: Low-weight answers do not derail core recommendations
Visible in blueprint report as 'Key Drivers'

stages.name: Confidence Scoring
stages.description: Each recommendation shows confidence % based on answer completeness.
acceptanceCriteria: Score calculated from number of answered stages vs total
Low confidence triggers follow-up questions before results

stages.name: AI Memory Between Sessions
stages.description: Remember customer preferences and history across sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Previous project history visible in dashboard

stages.name: Expanded Space Taxonomy
stages.description: Every space has: area range, volume range, occupant capacity, climate zone suitability, default lux levels, default acoustic targets, default temp range.
acceptanceCriteria: All 14 space categories expanded with 50+ subtypes each
Each space record has: id, name, category, areaSqftMin, areaSqftMax, defaultLux, defaultTempC, acousticTargetRT60, climateZones
Aliases normalized for natural language matching

stages.name: Room Characteristics Matrix
stages.description: Map spaces to compatible materials, styles, and products.

stages.name: Product Intelligence Enrichment
stages.description: Every product gains rich metadata beyond current catalog fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Each product has: compatibleSpaces, compatibleStyles, compatibleEmotions, incompatibleSpaces, incompatibleStyles
Each product has: maintenanceSchedule, cleaningMethod, installationComplexity, durabilityRating (1-5)
Each product has: climateSuitability, sustainabilityScore, warrantyYears, expectedLifespanYears

stages.name: Compatibility Matrix
stages.description: System knows which products work together, conflict, or require each other.
acceptanceCriteria: incompatibleWith: explicit product pairs with reason
enhances: products that amplify this product's effect

stages.name: Product Confidence Scoring
stages.description: Each recommendation tied to product shows confidence based on knowledge graph completeness.
acceptanceCriteria: Displayed as star rating or percentage

stages.name: Material Intelligence Taxonomy
stages.description: Comprehensive library of interior design materials with technical and sensory data.
acceptanceCriteria: Each material has: id, name, category, subcategory, textureDescription, tactileRating (1-5)
Each material has: acousticAbsorption (NRC value), thermalConductivity, lightReflectance
Each material has: maintenanceLevel, durability, sustainabilityScore, cost Tier
Each material has: compatibleWith array, incompatibleWith array
Each material has: suitableSpaces array, suitableStyles array

stages.name: Material Compatibility Engine
stages.description: Rules for combining materials in same space.

stages.name: Color Intelligence Database
stages.description: Every color linked to emotion, energy level, and spatial effect.
acceptanceCriteria: Each color has: hex, name, emotionEffect, energyLevel (1-10), lightReflectance, heatAbsorption
Complementary, analogous, and triadic relationships defined

stages.name: Color Palettes by Theme
stages.description: Curated palettes for each design theme with psychological reasoning.
acceptanceCriteria: Each palette has: primary, secondary, accent, neutral, statement
Reasoning explains why palette suits theme's emotional goal

stages.name: Lux Calculation Engine
stages.description: Calculate required lumens and lux levels for any space type.
acceptanceCriteria: Default lux values mapped per space type in spaces.json
Adjusts for ceiling height, wall reflectance, task type

stages.name: Lighting Scene Presets
stages.description: Circadian, cinematic, task, and ambient presets.
acceptanceCriteria: Preset IDs: circadian-day, circadian-evening, cinematic, task-focused, ambient-glow
Each preset defines: colorTempK, brightness%, sceneDuration, transitionTime
Presets auto-suggested based on dailyRhythm answer

stages.name: Product-to-Light Mapping
stages.description: Every lighting product tagged with compatible spaces and scenes.
acceptanceCriteria: Products in lighting categories have: beamAngle, cri, ipRating, dimmable, compatibleScenes
Recommender can suggest complete lighting plan per room

stages.name: Why-Explanation Generator
stages.description: Every recommendation explains the reasoning in natural language.
acceptanceCriteria: Each recommendation card has: primaryReason, supportingReasons[], counterConsiderations[]
Primary reason references the user's specific answer

stages.name: Counter-Suggestion Logic
stages.description: If user preference conflicts with optimal design, show alternative with explanation.
acceptanceCriteria: When user picks option X but Y is objectively better for their goal, show Y as 'Alternative'
Politely explain tension (e.g., 'You chose dark walls for a room with limited daylight. Lighter finishes would reflect more natural light and improve circadian health.')

stages.name: Confidence Calibration
stages.description: Recommendation confidence accurately reflects knowledge gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: If confidence < 60%, prompt user for additional inputs before final results

stages.name: Structured Blueprint Reports
stages.description: Auto-generated multi-section report after consultation.
acceptanceCriteria: Sections: Executive Summary, Space DNA, Emotional DNA, Design Philosophy, Material Strategy, Lighting Plan, Air & Wellness Strategy, Furniture Strategy, Technology Strategy, Budget Options, Implementation Roadmap, Maintenance Guide
Each section 2-4 paragraphs with specific recommendations
Exportable as PDF via browser print

stages.name: Visual Blueprint Aesthetics
stages.description: Blueprint rendered in obsidian-noir styling with blueprint grid background.
acceptanceCriteria: Section dividers: gold lines with measurement markers

stages.name: Project Management Dashboard
stages.description: Customer view of their projects, consultations, and orders.
acceptanceCriteria: Saved mood boards and product wishlists

stages.name: Member Benefits Portal
stages.description: Exclusive access for membership tiers.

stages.name: Quotation Builder
stages.description: Generate professional quotes from recommendation carts.
acceptanceCriteria: Quote items: products, services, materials, labor

stages.name: BOQ Generator
stages.description: Bill of Quantities with spec-level detail.
acceptanceCriteria: Grouped by trade: civil, MEP, joinery, FF&E

stages.name: Procurement Lists
stages.description: Convert BOQ to vendor-ready procurement lists.

stages.name: Installation Workflow
stages.description: Track installation tasks, milestones, and quality checks.

stages.name: Product Management
stages.description: CRUD for products, materials, categories.

stages.name: Customer & Order Management
stages.description: View customers, orders, consultations, and projects.

stages.name: AI & Content Management
stages.description: Manage prompt templates, recommendation rules, and content.
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendation rule editor with live preview

stages.name: Tiered Membership Model
stages.description: Comfort, Premium, Luxury, Signature, Bespoke tiers with escalating benefits.
acceptanceCriteria: Each tier has: price, benefits list, exclusive collections, consultation priority

stages.name: Long-term Engagement Engine
stages.description: Keep customers engaged post-project.

stages.name: Report Generator Core
stages.description: Template-based report generation from consultation state.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates for: Consultation Summary, Emotional DNA Report, Space DNA Report, Design Philosophy Report, Material Report, Lighting Report, Air & Wellness Report, Furniture Strategy, Technology Strategy, Budget Options, Implementation Roadmap, Maintenance Guide

stages.name: Report Delivery System
stages.description: Email, in-app, and download delivery.

stages.name: HVAC Intelligence
stages.description: Recommend HVAC specs based on space analysis.

stages.name: Air Quality Intelligence
stages.description: Air purification, ventilation, and fragrance strategies.

stages.name: Biophilic Design Engine
stages.description: Plants, water features, and natural material integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Plant recommendations by space type and light level

stages.name: IoT Control Layer
stages.description: Unified control for lighting, HVAC, AV, and security.
acceptanceCriteria: Protocol support: KNX, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter

stages.name: Energy Optimization
stages.description: Reduce energy consumption through smart scheduling.

stages.name: Problem-Solving Reasoning
stages.description: AI explains 'why' not just 'what' for every recommendation.
acceptanceCriteria: Natural language explanations referencing space analysis
Trade-off explanations when budget conflicts with optimal
Step-by-step reasoning chain visible in blueprint

stages.name: Contextual Q&A
stages.description: Customer can ask follow-up questions and get contextual answers.
acceptanceCriteria: Can modify recommendations based on Q&A

stages.name: Predictive Analytics
stages.description: Predict future needs based on lifestyle trends.

stages.name: AR Visualization
stages.description: WebAR product placement in real spaces.

stages.name: Digital Twin Integration
stages.description: Realtime environmental monitoring twin of designed space.

stages.name: Voice Concierge
stages.description: Natural language control of entire environment.
